description: Dybdedata - terrengmodeller 5 meters grid Søre Sunnmøre is a dataset listed in National Single Information Point of Norway, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Kartverket. Datasettet viser terrengvariasjoner på havbunnen i Søre Sunnmøre. Terrengmodellene har blitt produsert av innsamlede sjømålingsdata av høy kvalitet. Tilgjengeliggjort som georeferert tiff-fil med 5 meters oppløsning. Coverage: Kartverket. The publisher named on the listing is Kartverket. Its keywords include Herøy, Vanylven, Basis geodata, Dybdedata, Hareid, Ulstein. The listing shows 1 download or service links in TIFF. The listing shows 2017-06-08 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/noConditionsApply). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nsip-no.
